description_en: Adds a whitelist for an instance. Only new-architecture instances are supported, specifically instances whose VPC endpoints or VPC PrivateLink endpoints end with mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com
description_zh:
增加实例白名单
只支持新架构实例，即VPC接入点（或者VPC PrivateLink 接入点）以mq.amqp.aliyuncs.com结尾的实例
name: AddInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID for which you want to create an IP address or VPC whitelist
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The IP addresses or VPC IDs to be added to the whitelist. IP addresses must be specified as CIDR blocks
parameters.help_zh: 白名单IP或vpcId，IP以网段的形式设置
parameters.name: white_list_item

parameters.help_en:
The whitelist type.

A value of 1 indicates an IP address whitelist.

A value of 2 indicates a VPC ID whitelist.

VPC whitelists apply only to instances whose VPC endpoints are of the anytunnel type. The VPC endpoints of the latest instance versions are of the PrivateLink type. You cannot configure VPC whitelists for PrivateLink endpoints
parameters.help_zh:
白名单类型。

WhiteListType为1，IP白名单类型；

WhiteListType为2，VPCID白名单类型；

vpc白名单仅针对vpc接入点是anytunnel类型的实例。最新版本实例vpc接入点为privateLink类型，不能针对privateLink设置vpc白名单
parameters.name: white_list_type

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful

StatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code returned. A value of 200 indicates success
StatusCode.description_zh: 调用返回码，200标识为成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful
